name: Alter Age, Greater
body:
School necromancy (aging); Level cleric 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9

CASTING

Components V, S

Duration 1 hour/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as alter age† except you can advance or regress the target’s age to any age category of your choice, even if the creature’s age is unknown.

If you cast this spell on an object, construct, or undead creature, it either takes 10 points of damage per caster level you possess or heals 10 points of damage per caster level you possess, to a maximum of 250 points.
